english.title: Unauthorised disclosure of information by immigration custody officer
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been employed as

(A)_[a detainee custody officer]_
(B)_[a prisoner custody officer]_
(C)_[**(..SPECIFY CAPACITY OF EMPLOYMENT..)]_

(D)_[in accordance with escort arrangements,]_
(E)_[at a contracted out detention centre,]_
(F)_[to perform contracted out functions at a directly managed detention centre,]_

disclosed, otherwise than in the course of your duty, or as authorised by the Secretary of State information, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..), which you acquired in the course of your employment and which related to a particular detained person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 158(1) and (2) of the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
employed as detainee /prisoner custody officer
in accordance with escort arrangement OR
at contracted out detention centre OR
to perform contracted out function
at directly managed detention centre
disclose information otherwise than in course of duty or
as authorised by Secretary of State
which you acquired in course of your employment
and which related to a detained person

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: See Section 150 for basis of 'contracted out functions' which are entered into as a result of entering into a contract as described under this section.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
